---
title: "Plot detected virus strains on tree-like object with prevalence and distributions labeling"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(rprojroot)
library(ade4)
library(ggtree)
library(wesanderson)
library(eoffice)

# Set paths and filenames
virome_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table3.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
metadata_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table3.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Load files
virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = T)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = T)

# Create a hierarchical tax table for each detected strain
hierarchical_dt <- virome_dt %>% 
  distinct(species, genus, family, order, class, phylum) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(species != "NA") %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species)) %>%
  mutate(genus = gsub("\\W+", "", genus)) %>%
  mutate(family = gsub("\\W+", "", family)) %>%
  mutate(order = gsub("\\W+", "", order)) %>%
  mutate(class = gsub("\\W+", "", class)) %>%
  mutate(phylum = gsub("\\W+", "", phylum)) 

hierarchical_df <- as.data.frame(hierarchical_dt) 
hierarchical_df <- as.data.frame(unclass(hierarchical_df), stringsAsFactors = TRUE, row.names = "species")
cols <- colnames(hierarchical_df)

tax.phy <- taxo2phylog(as.taxo(hierarchical_df))

# Summarize distinct counts of families, genera, species, and strains
virome_dt %>% 
  filter(strain != "NA") %>%
  summarize(families = n_distinct(family),
            genera = n_distinct(genus),
            species = n_distinct(species),
            strains = n_distinct(strain))

# Group RPKMF by sample_ID and species
species_abund_dt <- virome_dt %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, species) %>%
  summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF)) %>%
  ungroup()

species_meta_dt <- merge(species_abund_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID") %>%
  group_by(City) %>%
  mutate(total_samples = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(species, City, total_samples) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / total_samples) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(nesting(City, total_samples), species, fill = list(n = 0, freq = 0))

important_info_dt <- species_meta_dt %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(total_number = sum(n),
         h_freq = freq / sum(freq)) %>%
  filter(City == "Guangzhou") %>%
  select(species, total_number, h_freq) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species)) %>%
  filter(species != "NA")

important_info_df <- important_info_dt %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species))
important_info_df <- as.data.frame(important_info_df, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, row.names = "species")

# Plot treelike object
t1 <- ggtree(tax.phy, layout = "circular", color = "grey30")

pal <- wes_palette("Zissou1", 2, type = "continuous")

lab_t1 <- t1 %<+% important_info_dt + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = h_freq, size = total_number), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = pal[1], high = pal[2], 
    mid = "#F2E191", midpoint = 0.5,
    breaks = c(0.20, 0.50, 0.80),
    labels = c("Nanning only", "Equally Distributed", "Guangzhou only"),
    guide = guide_colorbar(title = NULL)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 100, 200, 300),
    name = "total detections \n(max 270)"
  ) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 247, label = "Hepadnaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 251, label = "Retroviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 258, label = "Polyomaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 262, label = "Papillomaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 269, label = "Parvoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 282, label = "Circoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 288, label = "Reoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 290, label = "Sedoreoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 295, label = "Spinareoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 304, label = "Hepeviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 310, label = "Togaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 313, label = "Flaviviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 318, label = "Luteoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 320, label = "Tombusviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 325, label = "Arenaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 329, label = "Orthomyxoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 335, label = "Paramyxoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 340, label = "Pneumoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 347, label = "Herpesviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 354, label = "Picobirnaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 359, label = "Coronaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 365, label = "Cremegaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 367, label = "Mesoniviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 369, label = "Tobaniviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 373, label = "Caliciviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 376, label = "Dicistroviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 381, label = "Iflaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 384, label = "Picornaviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 392, label = "Secoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 398, label = "Solemoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 403, label = "Astroviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 410, label = "Adenoviridae", hjust = -0.1, fontsize = 3) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Output the plot to a PPTX file
pptx_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/virus_tax_tree_prevalence1.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(lab_t1, filename = pptx_filename, height = 7, width = 9)
```
